welcome.title: Welcome to YomiFlow
welcome.subtitle: Your offline Japanese immersion and study hub.
welcome.description: To ensure the best experience with stroke evaluation (Kanji Pad) and high-precision manga OCR (MangaOCR), let's set up your essential local engines in 2 quick steps.
welcome.feature_ai_desc: Neural extraction of speech bubbles without uploading anything to the cloud.
welcome.feature_kanjivg_desc: Geometric stroke order evaluation for Japanese kanji.

ai_step.title: AI Upgrade (MangaOCR)
ai_step.subtitle: ONNX neural model for reading furigana and vertical texts.
ai_step.ready_desc: The manga-ocr.onnx file is ready for local inference.
ai_step.info_desc: The model runs locally without sending data to external servers. If you choose not to download now, YomiFlow will fallback to Tesseract.

kanjivg_step.title: KanjiVG Import (Optional)
kanjivg_step.subtitle: SVG vectors to practice and evaluate kanji with geometric precision.
kanjivg_step.success_desc: Kanji Pad engine can now validate stroke orders and vectors.
kanjivg_step.description: If you have an uncompressed KanjiVG project folder (*.svg files), select it below to import strokes into SQLite.
kanjivg_step.hint: You can also do this at any time in settings or dictionary.
kanjivg_step.importing: Importing vector strokes in background... Please wait.
kanjivg_step.folder_dialog_title: Select folder containing KanjiVG SVG files
